violation_type.title: Required Admission Information - Parents' Phone Numbers (26 TAC §747.605(5))
violation_type.short_title: Required Admission Information - Parents' Phone Numbers
violation_type.typical_finding: Four child files were evaluated. One child in care did not have parent or emergency contact information on file.

finding_variants.text: Four child files were evaluated. One child in care did not have parent or emergency contact information on file.
Several children's records did not have emergency contact information completed.

The admission information form was missing the following information:  Address, and telephone number of another responsible individual (friend or relative)who should be contacted in an emergency when the parent cannot be reached, Names and telephone numbers of persons other than a parent to whom the child may be released, Authorization to obtain emergency medical care and to transport the child for emergency medical treatment, A statement of the child's special care needs.
One out of eight children records reviewed was missing the phone number for parent(s).
One child did not have parent contact information on file.
